info.title: CWS Next App API
info.description: Automated API documentation for the CWS Next App. This document is generated from Zod schemas and route handler metadata.

get.description: Returns the health status of the application and its database connection. Returns 200 when healthy, 503 when degraded.

post.description: Sends a contact form submission to the configured Google Sheets script. Inputs are sanitized (HTML stripped) and validated before forwarding. Returns 502 if the upstream service is unreachable, 504 on timeout.

message.example: I would like to discuss a potential partnership opportunity.

400.description: Validation failed (missing fields, invalid email, length exceeded)

502.description: Upstream Google Sheets service returned an error

504.description: Request timed out connecting to Google Sheets (8s timeout)

post.description: Sends a message to the ZXY Intelligent Sourcing Co-Pilot (Google Gemini). Requires authentication (cookie or bearer). Returns a simulated response when the Gemini API key is not configured.

message.description: User message to send to the ZXY Co-Pilot
message.example: What sustainable fabrics do you recommend for a summer polo shirt?

text.example:
*Based on ZXY sustainable sourcing parameters:*

For a summer polo, we recommend GOTS-certified 100% Organic Cotton at 180 GSM.

500.description: Gemini API error (message not disclosed to client)

post.description: Generates passwordless passkey authentication options for this enrolled device.

email.description: Account email for email-first passkey login

401.description: Passkey is not available for this device

post.description: Verifies a passwordless passkey response for this enrolled device. On success, issues dashboard session cookies or redirects to email verification for high-risk sign-ins.

email.description: Account email used to start passkey login

401.description: Passkey is not available for this device or challenge expired

post.description: Generates passkey registration options for the active dashboard session.
Verifies a passkey registration response and stores the credential for the active dashboard user.
Revokes the current session and all refresh tokens in the family, then clears session, refresh, and device token cookies. Protected by CSRF (Origin/Referer check).

403.description: CSRF validation failed (missing or mismatched Origin/Referer)

post.description: Same-origin HTML form endpoint. On completion it returns a 303 redirect to the dashboard, an MFA/password-change step, or the login page with a safe error code.

303.description: Authentication flow redirect; secure cookies may be set.

post.description: Rotates the refresh token, issuing a new session cookie and refresh cookie. On reuse detection, revokes the entire session family and clears cookies. Protected by CSRF (Origin/Referer check). The refresh token is read from the cws_refresh cookie.

200.description: Token rotated successfully — new cookies set

401.description: No refresh token, token expired, or token revoked/reused

get.description: Diagnostic route that sets a test cookie and redirects to the dashboard login page.

303.description: Redirect to dashboard login after setting a test cookie.

get.description: Initiates the Google Authorization Code + PKCE flow. Sets a short-lived httpOnly state cookie containing the PKCE verifier and nonce, then redirects to Google consent screen. Returns 503 if Google OAuth is not configured.

302.description: Redirect to Google OAuth consent screen

error.example: Google sign-in is not available. Contact an administrator.

get.description: Completes the Google OAuth flow. Verifies state (CSRF), exchanges the authorization code, verifies the id_token, links/looks up the user, and issues session + refresh cookies. Handles MFA-required, force-password-change, and step-up statuses by setting pending cookies and redirecting to the appropriate verification page. Rate-limited to 20 attempts per IP per 15 minutes.

Location.description: Redirect URL. Possible destinations: /dashboard/ (success), /dashboard/verify-2fa (MFA required or step-up), /dashboard/change-password (force password change), /dashboard/login/?error=... (failure)

post.description: Authenticates a user with email and password for the mobile API. Returns JWT tokens on success, or MFA challenge if 2FA is enabled. Returns 403 if the user must change their password.

202.description: MFA required — use challengeToken to complete login

post.description: Completes email-based MFA verification using the challenge token and 6-digit code. Returns JWT tokens on success.
Completes TOTP-based MFA verification using the challenge token and 6-digit code. Returns JWT tokens on success.
Deprecated. Passkeys are available for passwordless sign-in only; use email code for verification.

410.description: WebAuthn MFA is no longer supported

post.description: Deprecated. Passkeys are available for passwordless sign-in only; use email code for verification.

410.description: WebAuthn MFA is no longer supported

post.description: Mobile passkey registration is unavailable until mobile device binding is supported.
Mobile passkey registration is unavailable until mobile device binding is supported.
Mobile passkey login is unavailable until mobile device binding is supported.
Mobile passkey login is unavailable until mobile device binding is supported.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile including role, status, and profile details. Requires a valid mobile bearer JWT.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing or invalid bearer token

post.description: Rotates the refresh token, issuing a new JWT access token and refresh token. The session must be a mobile platform session.

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token from previous authentication

401.description: Invalid, expired, or revoked refresh token

post.description: Authenticates a user with a Google ID token for the mobile API. Returns JWT tokens on success, or MFA challenge if 2FA is enabled.

idToken.description: Google ID token from Google Sign-In SDK

202.description: MFA required — use challengeToken to complete login

post.description: Revokes the session associated with the provided refresh token. Always returns 200 with { ok: true } regardless of whether a valid token was provided.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token to revoke. If omitted, returns success without revocation.

get.description: Retrieve a user profile by their MongoDB ObjectId. Requires a valid mobile bearer JWT. The requesting user must be an admin or be fetching their own profile.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The MongoDB ObjectId of the user

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include

schema.description: Comma-separated list of fields to include in the response. If omitted, all fields are returned.

get.summary: Get mobile JWKS (JSON Web Key Set)
get.description: Returns the public keys used to verify mobile JWT access tokens. Clients should cache the response for up to 5 minutes (Cache-Control: public, max-age=300). Returns 503 if mobile authentication is not configured.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a new category.

put.description: Admin only. Updates an existing category.

post.description: Admin only. Creates a new product.

put.description: Admin only. Updates an existing product.

post.description: Admin only. Revokes sessions for a specific user, or globally if no userId is provided.

userId.description: Optional user ID to revoke. If omitted, revokes all sessions globally.

get.description: Admin only. Retrieves page section configurations.

definition.description: Editor capabilities including content fields and named media slots.

patch.summary: Update section visibility, content, or a named media slot
patch.description: Admin only. Saves section-aware content and visibility, replaces a named media slot, or resets a slot to its default.

mediaSlot.description: Named slot from the section definition. Legacy requests without this field target the primary slot.

status.description: Retained for compatibility; it does not control public visibility.
Retained for compatibility; it does not control public visibility.

post.description: Deprecated compatibility operation. Catalog public visibility is automatic.

cookieAuth.name: cws_session
cookieAuth.description: HMAC-signed session cookie issued by the web dashboard login flow. Obtained via POST /api/auth/login (Server Action) or Google OAuth callback.

bearerAuth.description: Ed25519-signed JWT issued by the mobile authentication endpoints. Obtained via POST /api/mobile/v1/auth/password or /api/mobile/v1/auth/google.

pendingSession.name: cws_2fa_pending
pendingSession.description: Short-lived HMAC-signed pending session cookie set during MFA challenge. Valid for 5 minutes. Used by WebAuthn and TOTP verification endpoints.
